title: Symone wins Season 13
summary: In the Grand Finale (US-S13-E16), Symone was crowned America's Next Drag Superstar after a Lip Sync Smackdown for the Crown. Kandy Muse finished as runner-up; Gottmik and Rosé placed third. The Season 13 cash prize was $100,000. LaLa Ri was announced as Miss Congeniality.

title: Gottmik becomes the first openly transgender man on Drag Race
summary: Season 13 welcomed Gottmik as the franchise's first openly transgender man (assigned female at birth) to compete on RuPaul's Drag Race. He finished in a third-place tie with Rosé after Gettin' Lucky (US-S13-E14).

title: Kandy Muse's fake sashay and double shantay
summary: On Social Media: The Unverified Rusical (US-S13-E08), Kandy Muse and Symone lip-synced to Fifth Harmony's "Boss." RuPaul told Kandy to sashay away, then revealed it was a fake elimination and declared both winners — a double shantay that kept the Top 9 intact.

title: LaLa Ri named Miss Congeniality
summary: LaLa Ri was voted Miss Congeniality by her Season 13 sisters and announced at the Grand Finale (US-S13-E16), after being eliminated on Bossy Rossy RuBoot (US-S13-E07).
